title: DraftWise Alternative for Lawyers: Lexi Compared
summary: Compare DraftWise and Lexi for legal drafting, proofreading, redlining and India or Singapore workflows. See published capabilities and what to test.
body_markdown:
**Published:** 14 November 2026


## DraftWise alternative for lawyers: the short answer


[Lexi](https://www.getlexi.io/compare) is a DraftWise alternative worth evaluating if your team wants legal drafting within Microsoft Word alongside research, documents and matter management. If proofreading or redlining is a deciding requirement, test the exact task with both products rather than assuming that a general drafting claim covers it.


The products have different published emphases.[DraftWise](https://draftwise.com/) describes drafting, redlining and research using a team’s proprietary precedent and standards.[Lexi](https://www.getlexi.io/compare) describes a workspace connecting research, documents and matter management from intake to final draft, from a[company with offices in India and Singapore](https://www.getlexi.io/) . The better fit depends on the documents, review process and systems your team uses.


## DraftWise vs Lexi: published capabilities


This comparison reports what the vendors say publicly. An unmentioned capability is not necessarily unavailable; use a demonstration and a written proposal to establish what your team would receive.


Evaluation point DraftWise Lexi


Intended users[Big Law, Mid Law and in-house teams](https://draftwise.com/) .[Law firms, in-house legal teams and litigators](https://www.getlexi.io/) .


Published workflow scope[Drafting & Precedent Research, Playbook Studio, Deal Table and Knowledge Console](https://draftwise.com/product) .[Research, documents and matter management](https://www.getlexi.io/compare) in one workspace.


Drafting and precedent work[Drafting and research using proprietary precedent and standards](https://draftwise.com/) .[Drafting and document work](https://www.getlexi.io/compare) connected to research and matters.


Proofreading Ask for a demonstration of the proofreading checks your reviewers need. Ask for the same demonstration; do not infer proofreading from a drafting claim.


Redlining and comments[Says it reads redlines and comments and drafts responses](https://draftwise.com/) .[Lists redlining and editing documents](https://www.getlexi.io/compare) ; ask to see redline review, comment handling and the resulting document.


Microsoft Word[Says it drafts directly in Word](https://draftwise.com/product) .[States that lawyers can draft within Microsoft Word](https://www.getlexi.io/compare) .


Playbooks and deal terms[Describes playbooks and checklists; says it shows similar terms from past deals in tables and compares revisions against EDGAR market benchmarks](https://draftwise.com/) .[Lists playbook-based review and contract clause analysis](https://www.getlexi.io/compare) ; ask how your standards would be applied.


Matter and client workflow Ask how the proposed deployment connects with your existing matter systems.[Lists case chronologies, deadline tracking, client onboarding and client collaboration](https://www.getlexi.io/compare) .


India and Singapore fit Confirm availability, contracting and support for your location.[Has offices in India and Singapore (head office in Singapore)](https://www.getlexi.io/) ; confirm contracting and support for your team.


Published security and data statements[DraftWise references SOC 2 Type II and says it does not use customer data to train public models and mirrors DMS permissions](https://draftwise.com/) . Review its[security portal](https://security.draftwise.com/) for current assurance materials.[Lexi says client data is never used to train its models and offers a choice of where data lives](https://www.getlexi.io/compare) . Request deployment-specific data-use, hosting and assurance documents.


Price and plan scope Request a quote identifying the modules and services included.[The comparison page invites a demo](https://www.getlexi.io/compare) ; request a quote identifying the features and services included.


Security statements are not interchangeable with contractual commitments. For either product, request the current SOC 2 report or ISO certificate where claimed, check its dates and scope, and review the terms applicable to your deployment. A general reference to India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 or the EU GDPR does not establish compliance for your proposed use.


## When should lawyers consider a DraftWise alternative?


Consider alternatives when the selection turns on a workflow beyond finding and applying precedent, or when several stages of work must stay connected. The useful questions are specific:


- **Is proofreading a distinct review step?** Give both vendors a representative document and specify the errors, inconsistencies and formatting issues reviewers expect to find.
- **How are counterparty markups handled?**[DraftWise says it reads redlines and comments and drafts responses](https://draftwise.com/) . Test how each product presents proposed changes, preserves reviewer control and returns a usable document.
- **Must work stay in Microsoft Word?**[Lexi states that drafting happens within Word](https://www.getlexi.io/compare) .[DraftWise also says it works directly in Word](https://draftwise.com/product) . Test both proposed workflows with your templates, permissions and document-handling practices.
- **Does the team need matter coordination?**[Lexi lists chronologies, deadlines, onboarding and client collaboration](https://www.getlexi.io/compare) . Determine whether those functions fit your existing matter process rather than comparing them with drafting features alone.
- **Does location affect procurement?** For an India or Singapore team, establish who will contract, what support is available and which data-location terms can be agreed.


For a wider selection framework, see[Best AI for Legal Drafting in 2026](https://www.getlexi.io/blog/best-ai-for-legal-drafting-in-2026) .


## How to compare DraftWise and Lexi on real work


Use the same approved test materials and a defined review standard for both products. A short exercise based on your actual documents is more useful than an open-ended prompt demonstration.


1. **Choose representative documents.** Include a starting precedent, a counterparty markup and the playbook or standards your lawyers use. Follow your organisation’s approval process before sharing client or confidential material.
2. **Separate the tasks.** Evaluate precedent retrieval, first-draft preparation, proofreading, comment response, redline review and matter coordination individually. Performance on one task does not establish fit for another.
3. **Inspect the review loop.** Have a lawyer review proposed language, edit it and deliver the resulting document. If Word is essential, perform the test in your organisation’s Word environment.
4. **Compare outputs against your standards.** Record whether the work preserves defined terms, follows the relevant playbook, identifies issues a reviewer cares about and makes proposed changes easy to accept or reject.
5. **Assess the proposed deployment.** Obtain the plan scope, integration approach, implementation responsibilities, support arrangements and applicable data terms in writing.


## Evaluating a DraftWise alternative with proofreading and redlining


Proofreading, redlining and comment response are different jobs. A proofreading test might focus on cross-references, defined terms and internal consistency. A redlining test should show how a lawyer examines proposed changes against a marked-up document. A comment-response test should show what the tool proposes, what the lawyer can change and what is returned to the other side.


[DraftWise expressly describes reading redlines and comments and drafting responses](https://draftwise.com/) .[Lexi’s comparison page lists redlining, document editing and playbook-based review, but does not describe a separate proofreading check](https://www.getlexi.io/compare) . Ask both vendors to demonstrate each required task separately. Do not treat a missing public claim as proof that a feature does not exist.


## Procurement questions for India and Singapore teams


Once a workflow passes the practical test, put the commercial and deployment questions to each vendor:


- Which features, modules and services are included in the proposed plan?
- How will the product work with the team’s Word environment, document systems, identity systems and matter systems?
- What permissions, retention, data-location and data-use terms will apply to the proposed deployment?
- Who will provide implementation, training and support in the team’s location, and on what timetable?
- Can the agreed proofreading, redlining and comment-response workflow be documented before purchase?


These answers matter more than a feature count: they establish whether the version being purchased can support the team’s actual review process.


## DraftWise alternative: FAQs


### What is the best DraftWise alternative?


There is no single best choice for every legal team.[DraftWise’s published strengths centre on proprietary precedent, playbooks and deal-term work](https://draftwise.com/) .[Lexi is an option for teams evaluating Word drafting alongside research, documents and matter management](https://www.getlexi.io/compare) , particularly in India and Singapore. Select on the basis of demonstrated workflows and the terms offered to your organisation, not an assumed capability or an absent website claim.


### Is DraftWise available in India?


[DraftWise’s public positioning](https://draftwise.com/) identifies Big Law, Mid Law and in-house teams, but that alone does not establish the contracting or support arrangements for an India-based team. Ask DraftWise directly about availability for your proposed use, including deployment and support. The same procurement questions apply to a Singapore-based team.


### Does Lexi work in Microsoft Word?


Yes.[Lexi states that lawyers can draft within Microsoft Word](https://www.getlexi.io/compare) . Its[Word Add-In overview](https://www.getlexi.io/blog/lexi-launches-word-add-in-for-lawyers) provides more detail. Test the current feature scope and compatibility with your organisation’s Microsoft environment as part of the evaluation.
